summary: Learn scoops from a flat palm up to the forehead, closing the hand as it rises, like picking up knowledge and putting it in your head.
handshape: Open hand closing to a flattened O, over a flat palm
movement: Scoop up from the palm to the forehead
steps: Hold your non-dominant hand flat, palm up.
Place your open dominant hand on it, fingertips down.
Lift the hand to your forehead, closing the fingers as it rises, and touch the forehead.
mistakes: Stopping before the forehead. The knowledge has to arrive.
